OPENADMET CYP INHIBITION BLIND CHALLENGE

CYPMode

Time-dependent CYP inhibition and CYP3A4–ligand structures, predicted by models whose every addition passed a pre-registered gate.

TDI classification · CYP3A4 and CYP2D6Structure prediction · CYP3A4 · 20 ligands

Public crystal structures of CYP3A4 from the PDB: the enzyme with fluconazole and six complexes with imidazole and pyridine ligands; the circled nitrogen of each drawing is the Type II donor, and the dashed line in the viewer joins it to the heme iron. The project's own 20 predicted structures are published after the challenge closes. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, hover an atom of the ligand or the heme to name it. Structures: wwPDB. Drawings: RDKit. Viewer: 3Dmol.js (BSD-3-Clause), bundled in this file; the page makes no request.
